dialogs.text: Hello, darkness, my old friend...
Whoa... It's a... child who talks like an adult? That's so weird!
Huh? Wait, isn't this the magnificent Magnifico?
Mag... what?
Mag... Magnifico, the magnificent Magnifico!
Uh... I know that if anything, I look a bit down-on-out right now, but please, give me some water... Help me out here...
Water... Please... Thank you...
Wow... He's looking half-dead again... Should we help him?
Not sure where we're getting "magnificent" from...
Yeah, you've kinda dried out like a fish... Poor thing...
Hey! Have some human empathy, will you?
Hello, old friend. It's me, darkness.
...What?
Haha! Yeah, that's the one! I love that song too!
Ah... Simeon and Carbuncle... I never get tired of their music... But speaking of which, I lost my last job on their account. That's why I ended up here, taking this blasted risk...
Uh... but that's a story for later, haha. Right now, what really matters is, can you get me some water, please?
After all, well... Haha... It's just... sorry, but I'm dying of thirst here, hehe...
This is life or death we're talking about, and yours, too! What are you giggling about!?
No idea. Might be terminal lucidity.
Oh... huh!?
Hello, darkness, my old friend...
Whoa... It's a... child who talks like an adult? That's so weird!
Hey, didn't your parents teach you any respect for people like me? We little folk can do great things too, you know!
In truth, many great things are accomplished by tiny people like me...
Huh, he's even got a beard! That's... kinda... Urgh...
Don't you use my beard to shame me!
Hello, old friend. It's me, darkness.
Uh... No. No need to play along with me like that. What I mean to say is that I... haven't much time left.
...I see.
Wow, you're all dried up like a fish out of water... Poor you.
Wrrooo...
What? Hey! Where's your human empathy gone?
Give me water, would you? I'm dying of thirst over here, can't you see?
What would you like?
Ah, that's the stuff! This is the first time in the three days I've been stuck here that I've heard a human speak...!

I'll take 2 servings of Meal No. 9, one Big No. 9, one Meal No. 6 with extra sauce, one Meal No. 7, two servings of the No. 45, one with which I'll take some cheese, and a large glass of Fonta to top it all off.
Alright, and what else would you like?
Rrooo, Awrr?
What else do I need? What do you think? Water, you...! Can't you tell I'm parched?
Calm down. How should we help you?
Water... Please... Thank you...

<color=#00E1FFFF>Water... Please, get me some water</color>... Thank you...
Let's take a quick look at this guy. He's all laid out on the ground, and it doesn't look good!
You figure out a way to help the thirsty person, and you notice that his body seems to have grown a size bigger after getting some water in his system.
*cough* *pant* Haha, I see, so that was an Iktomisaurus trick... Just one of the reasons I'm here, if you must know.
Alright, just take it easy and drink some water before we talk!
*cough* No, no, I'll be fine. Thank you for saving me!
Magnifico de la Magnificans. Just "Magnifico" will do. As you can see, I am of noble Fontainian stock.
My old friends sometimes call me "The Detective," at times "Brutus," and sometimes "Mr. Mag"... But you two may call me whatever you wish.
That's... a whole load of random names. Suspicious, too!
Hroor...
What's with "The Detective"?
I once worked at the Marechaussee Phantom as a detective for a few years, working on several major cases with Inspector Frank Drebin. He eventually made Superintendent, while I retired.
Ah, those were unforgettable days...

A boy met a girl, the boy lost the girl, the girl searched for the boy, the boy forgot the girl, the boy remembered the girl, and the girl was crushed under one of the pretty Fontinalia Festival floats three times...
Okay, you can stop with your weird flashbacks now...
*cough* Anyway, after retiring from the Marechaussee Phantom, I was idle for a time, before deciding to become a photographer, capturing the vitality within people and objects...
That is why I am here in Natlan — home to the most shockingly dazzling elemental life forms!
Perhaps the most "shocking" thing of all is the way you almost bit it, right here...
Hehe, and you have my apologies for that. I will not forget that you saved my life.
Hmm.. Ah, yes. Could I have a look at your map for a moment? I'd... like to see where my next destination is—
Ah, wait... Where have my manners gone? I haven't even asked for your names yet!
#I'm {NICKNAME}.
#Call me Paimon! And this here is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!
Ehrroo!
#Wonderful, wonderful! {NICKNAME}... and Paimon. Names to remember, to be sure!
Ehrr? Roo? Raar—!
#Haha, relax, relax! I'll remember you too, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!
May we meet again soon in our respective journeys. Perhaps I might even need your help again... or perhaps you might need mine!
You're going that far out... Well, mind you don't get too thirsty, alright?
Haha, there's no way I'd do that! Let's meet again, shall we?
Magnifico quickly packs his bags and water supplies, then waves you goodbye.\nNot long after, his short silhouette disappears from sight.
"Brutus," you say...?
Ah, you might not know this, but I used to serve as a detective with the Marechaussee Phantom for a few years, serving under Inspector Frank Drebin.
There was once when we saw five people in robes attacking an old man with knives in the park, right in front of over a hundred people! And then, "bang, bang, bang, bang, bang!"
Laid them all out, no exceptions. Hah! "Do you feel lucky, punk?"
Whoa...
Wrraaa...
Later, the chief of police told me that they were Research Institute administrative staff rehearsing "Remuria."
Huh!?
Hence the name, "Brutus"!
Wooraarr?
It didn't matter, anyway. The Institute was shedding redundant staff at the time, so they'd have had to resign sooner or later.
As for "Mr. Mag"...?
Why, it's because of my extraordinary charm, of course. Such magnetism is mine that all who know me are inexorably drawn to me!
Ehh...?
Also... all unassuming metal objects, scattered Mora, small jewelry, and so on, will be inexplicably attracted to my pockets!
Aren't you more like "Mr. Klepto," then!?
Indeed, and that is one of my clan's great virtues!
Eee—！
You figure out a way to help the thirsty person, and you notice that his body seems to have grown a size bigger after getting some water in his system.
*pant* Ha... Ha... *cough* Th—Thank you... I could've... died back there... *sniffles*
So... This guy almost died of thirst right by the water's edge?
Huh? So the water was this close by... Anyway, thank you for saving me!
